_comment: Written by build-odds-history.mjs from data/odds-snapshot.json: every committed copy git can see plus the working-tree one. weeks rows are merged across runs and never removed or rewritten. One row per matchup per snapshot; pA is the chance manager a beats manager b as the site priced it at that moment. teams holds one row per team per finalized week: playoff and title are the site's playoffNow and titleNow from a snapshot taken between weeks, and a week there is replaced whole when read again.
